plugins.name: MyBatis SQL Visualizer
plugins.description: 写代码时不用启动应用：mapper XML、注解 SQL、iBatis 2.x sqlMap、MyBatis-Plus / MPJ 的 Wrapper 链（联表、联表更新与删除、子查询）直接还原成数据库真正会收到的那条 SQL，参数自动回填。｜ 运行后，SQL 日志页签实时看真实执行：Java agent 增强捕获（Application / Spring Boot / JAR 运行配置），或把 MyBatis / iBatis / Hibernate / JdbcTemplate 四族控制台日志粘进面板还原；真实参数与耗时放在一起，同结构聚类、去重、慢查询高亮、N+1 疑似检测，双击跳回源码。｜ 每条结果先过检查：方言写法、不安全的写操作、性能规则与回滚计划。｜ 判不出来就标 unresolved 并给原因，绝不猜——服务未启，SQL 先知。｜ 工具窗五页签：SQL 日志、日志转 SQL、SQL 转 Java、历史、SQL 预览。｜ 12 个只读 MCP 工具把同一引擎交给 AI 智能体。｜ 交流群二维码：SQL 日志面板工具栏的对话气泡图标。｜ 权限用途（设置 › 插件 › 已安装 › 本插件的 Permissions 可随时勾选或取消）：读项目是还原 SQL 的根基；增强捕获需 java.agent 与 net:127.0.0.1（拒绝时用「日志转 SQL」粘贴还原，无需权限）；process:java 只用于启动哈希校验过的本地引擎 jar（EXPLAIN 与预览执行）；剪贴板两项只服务复制与导入。

0.1.7 — fix the host crash dialog ("timed out after 5s") on large projects.
- The automatic whole-project republish (install/enable/cold start and the idle wakeup) now runs inside a reporting background task: the host extends the call's wall-clock and CPU-fuel budget on every progress report, so sweeping thousands of Java files no longer trips the 5 s per-call limit and crashes the plugin. Cancellation is respected.
- Quick fixes now skip documents above the same 2 MiB cap the diagnostics already use, so one huge file cannot exhaust a provider call's budget either.
- No rule, diagnostic-message or scan-behavior changes; two regression tests added (reporting-task seam + size cap).

中文：0.1.7 — 修复大项目下的宿主崩溃框（"timed out after 5s"）。
- 自动全项目重发（安装/启用/冷启动与空闲唤醒）改为挂在带汇报的后台任务里：宿主按每次进度汇报续期墙钟与 CPU fuel 预算，扫数千个 Java 文件不再撞 5 秒单次调用上限而崩溃；支持取消。
- 快速修复跳过超过 2 MiB 的文档（与诊断同一上限），单个超大文件不再耗尽 provider 调用预算。
- 规则、诊断文案与扫描行为均无变化；新增两条回归测试（报告任务缝 + 大小上限）。

plugins.description: Symfony support in PHP, Twig, YAML and XML files. 0.3.6 — the navigation index now covers the routes the README lists beyond method/statement links: the interface declaration and its <mapper namespace="…"> share a graph key (Go to Definition on the namespace, gutter arrow on that line), and every mapper method parameter is a definition reached by #{…} / ${…} in the XML statement body. 0.3.5 — Navigation is back: gutter arrows and Go to Definition between a mapper interface and its XML (statements, result maps, sql/include, namespaces and annotation SQL), answered from the plugin's index graph; mapper links use a blue double-arrow badge that stands out from the default gutter glyph. A new command `MyBatis Duo: Go to Mapper XML` jumps from a mapper method to its XML statement and back — the command's declared shortcut is ⌥⌘B (Ctrl+Alt+B elsewhere); the IDE owns that key for Go to Implementation (Navigation Bar in the Eclipse keymap) and a plugin shortcut never takes a key the IDE already uses, so free that binding — or assign this command ⌥⌘B — in Settings › Keymap. Uninstall or disable the official MyBatis Navigator: `openidea.mybatis` and `qtvbwfn.mybatis-duo` are separate plugins and the host cannot tell them apart, so both would draw the same arrows twice.
